messages:
Priya Sharma: Quick draft posted — https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-link (hero + two CTA variants). Need a rapid pass on: 1) hero claim wording vs our benchmark deck, 2) registration routing (webinar vs demo) and fallback. Goal: copy lock by 10am PT tomorrow.

Miguel Torres: On it. Quick clarifying Q — are we prioritizing webinar signups as the main TOF metric, or pushing direct demo requests for enterprise leads? That affects CTAs and tracking.

Priya Sharma: Prioritize webinar for broad audience, but surface 'Request demo' for accounts with clear buying signals. We'll A/B hero CTA to measure which converts to SQLs.

Jess Lee: Webinar first makes sense. Routing notes: 
- Webinar CTA -> landing + HubSpot form 'prod_launch_webinar_v1'
- Demo CTA -> HubSpot form 'prod_demo_request' + push to workflow DEMO_QUEUE_V2
Seat cap: 200 for live; fallback CTA to 'watch recording' if full.

Sam Patel: Legal signoff needed on any quantitative claims in the hero (e.g., % reductions, Xx throughput). Also want two clear CTAs so ops can route.

Uma K (Legal): Read the draft. Can't approve absolute comparative claims without context. For example, 'reduces cost by 50%' needs timeframe and baseline. Recommendation: use cautious language — e.g., 'lowers per-token cost in typical production workloads; see benchmark details' — and link to the benchmark appendix. With that edit I'm comfortable. :white_check_mark:

Priya Sharma: Thanks Uma — changed hero to "Lowers per-token cost in typical production workloads" and added the benchmark link and short note about test conditions. Updated doc.

Miguel Torres: For analytics/UTMs please use this pattern (will make attribution clean):
```
utm_source=redwood
utm_medium=web|email
utm_campaign=prod_launch_webinar_v1
utm_content=cta_variant_a|cta_variant_b
internal_segment=webinar_registrant
```
Also surface `account_tier` for demo submissions so we can prioritize.

Jess Lee: Confirming HubSpot fields to set on submit: `hs_campaign=prod_launch_2026`, `lead_source=website`, `internal_segment=webinar_registrant`, `seat_preference=live|recording`. For demos: tag account with `early_access_2026`. Ops will subscribe to DEMO_QUEUE_V2.

Priya Sharma: Made the HubSpot & UTM suggestions in the doc (see the CTA mapping table). Lock window: copy lock 10am PT tomorrow. Any objections?

Sam Patel: No objections from me. :thumbsup: Locking copy at 10am PT.

Priya Sharma: Great — will ship A/B variant and brief ops on routing + add fallback landing for recording. Thanks all!
